links.outcome: Clinician diagnostic accuracy with versus without AI assistance on TEM images
links.effect: TEM-AID accuracy 0.886 (95% CI, 0.859-0.912) exceeded clinicians' unaided performance; clinicians' accuracy improved by a mean (SD) of 11.7% (5.2%) with TEM-AID.
links.quote: Clinicians' accuracy improved by a mean (SD) of 11.7% (5.2%) when they used TEM-AID.

links.outcome: Classification accuracy in internal versus external multicenter test sets
links.effect: Accuracy 0.911 (95% CI, 0.904-0.918) internally and 0.895 to 0.914 across external tests; macro-AUC 0.972 to 0.989 across cohorts.
links.quote: Subtype classification accuracy was 0.911 (95% CI, 0.904-0.918) in internal validation and 0.895 to 0.914 in external tests.

screen.reason: The study evaluated an AI diagnostic system for TEM kidney biopsy images and included a human-AI reader study testing clinician accuracy with versus without AI assistance.
